frequency_question: How often does a major central bank activate a non-zero CCyB within a comparable economic window?
membership_rule: Members are G20 central banks that have established a framework for the countercyclical capital buffer since the Basel III implementation window (2016-present), observed over any rolling 30-month period.

cases.name: Reserve Bank of New Zealand CCyB activation (2018)
Federal Reserve Board CCyB activation (2016-2026 window)

coverage_note: 16 observed jurisdiction-cycles; believed comprehensive for major early-adopter jurisdictions with established frameworks.
known_gaps: Excludes smaller emerging market jurisdictions that adopted the framework late or have insufficient data history.
skeleton: Developed market jurisdictions with operational macroprudential frameworks evaluated over rolling 30-month economic expansion phases
multiplier: 8 jurisdictions tracked over 2 distinct post-2016 economic cycles equals 16 observation windows; 11 total activations observed across these windows.
validity_reason: Matches the final resolution date of the forecasting question.
